name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LastPass.fat_reroute
title: Open: the fat reroute of the multi-pass masked GGH15 candidate with the comparator on the last copy (regime (d))
statement: Same scheme as equality_cube_flip. If rows^(2(2c-1)) >= 2^n and t < 2^n, then under decision LWE with k bits in the CVW18 regime, the hybrids (t, eq labelled mask') and (t+1, eq labelled mask) of lastPassView, which give every level string the same label and differ only in the comparator's class structure on the last copy, are CloseAt with loss (h+1) hopLoss(h, rows) and simulation cost simCost.
